description: Which peers may send Garmin credentials, MFA codes, test-activity, historical-recovery and latest-two requests over the app's web UI. HTTPS is always allowed. Plain HTTP is allowed only from loopback, private or link-local peers. Anything else gets HTTP 426. In the phone app, this applies to the embedded web server; the native UI on the phone itself is always local.
rules: IPv6: loopback ::1, unique-local fc00::/7, link-local fe80::/10.
Watch pairing token creation is stricter: HTTPS, or loopback only (not the LAN over HTTP).
